title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 — Section 23 (General prohibition of strikes and lock-outs)

content.overview: Section 23 imposes a general prohibition on strikes and lock-outs during conciliation, adjudication and arbitration proceedings.
content.glance: Section 23 imposes a general prohibition on strikes and lock-outs during conciliation, adjudication and arbitration proceedings.
content.study: No workman in any industrial establishment shall go on strike, and no employer shall lock out, during the pendency of conciliation before a Board, or of proceedings before a Labour Court, Tribunal or National Tribunal, or of arbitration, and for the prescribed period thereafter.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 23 imposes a general prohibition on strikes and lock-outs during conciliation, adjudication and arbitration proceedings.
